snippet.title: General Warfare A Card Game Official Trailer (Gameboy Homebrew)
snippet.description:
General Warfare A Card Game Official Trailer

This game is based on "War" the card game. This fast-paced game drops the player into various situations as they climb the ranks to become a 4-Star general. This game can be either chaotic or boring at times. 

There are many ways to win and play this game, so I encourage you to play through multiple times!

Music by: NotJam on itch.io

Game is available at: https://anthonycaruso247.itch.io/general-warfare-a-card-game

Check out my games page: https://anthonycaruso247.itch.io/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/antthedood.bsky.social
Twitter/X: https://x.com/AntTheDood
